h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Imphal

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Imphal

items.pText: Imphal sits in a wide valley ringed by hills, and Manipur has a strong sporting culture, from football to the traditional game that gave the world modern polo. Children here are used to running, climbing and competing. FunPlay Systems designs playground equipment that keeps up with them, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,250 km away, and sent to Manipur by road.

Older children soon lose interest in a small slide and a spring rider. For ages eight and up, we suggest equipment that tests strength and balance: climbing nets, rope bridges, balance beams and taller play towers. Younger children still need their own low pieces, placed in a separate zone. Imphal's monsoon is long and wet, so we build with galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts that do not rust or soak up water. Send us the age groups and the size of your ground to start.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Climbing nets and rope structures let several children climb at once, and they build grip and coordination. Balance beams and hopping pods set close to the ground offer a challenge with a low fall height. A taller tower from our NexLev series gives more height and more routes up and down. Keep the climbing zone apart from the junior area, with its own safe play area and rubber flooring underneath. Play rope carries our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 2,250 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What playground equipment suits children over eight?
items.a: Climbing nets, rope bridges, balance pieces and taller towers, which test strength and balance. We place them in a separate zone from the low equipment used by younger children.

items.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to Manipur?
items.a: Yes. We send orders from our Vasai factory to Imphal by road. Installation is carried out by our own team or a dealer who serves the Northeast.

items.q: Do rope nets last in Imphal's wet climate?
items.a: Play rope is made for outdoor use and carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Check knots and fixings after the monsoon and report any fraying to our after-sales team.
